name: Card Reversi
summary: 在 3×3 棋盘上翻转卡牌的对战游戏。卡牌插画与背景由 Stable Diffusion／DreamShaper 8 预生成并人工编辑；开发者声明文字、游戏逻辑和音乐不由 AI 生成。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: The card illustrations and backgrounds in this game were pre-generated by the developer using image-generation AI (Stable Diffusion / DreamShaper 8), then curated and edited by hand. Text, game logic, music, and fonts are NOT AI-generated. No content is generated by AI during gameplay (pre-generated, fixed assets only).
